name: align_center
description: Shift an object until its centre lands on the origin. 'reference' picks which centre: the bounding box, or the centre of mass. 'z' decides the vertical: 'center' includes Z in the move, 'floor' seats the lowest point at Z=0 for print-bed placement, 'keep' leaves the height alone.

name: align_lay_on_face
description: Turn an object until the face given aims straight down along -Z, then lower it so its lowest point rests at Z=0, the way a slicer's 'lay on face' does. The face may be a Part face ('Face3', or 'Pad.Face3' when it sits under a Body) or a mesh facet ('Facet123'); on a mesh, the flat region surrounding that facet sets the orientation.

angle_tolerance.description: Mesh only: degrees for growing the flat region

name: assembly_add_part
description: Attach a part, meaning any solid object, beneath an assembly as a child. This goes through the assembly's group property, so treat it as best-effort.

name: assembly_create
description: Start a new Assembly container in the active document.

name: bool_common
description: Intersect two or more objects, keeping only the volume they share.

name: bool_cut
description: Subtract the second object from the first. For a chain of subtractions, reach for bool_cut_many.

name: bool_fuse
description: Merge two or more objects into one by union, and return the feature that results.

name: console_clear
description: Empty the captured console buffer.

name: console_print
description: Write a message out to the FreeCAD console.

name: console_tail
description: Fetch the latest console output from FreeCAD: log, message, warning and error lines.

name: direct_chamfer
description: Bevel a solid's edges at the size given, editing the shape directly.

name: direct_fillet
description: Round a solid's edges to the radius given, editing the shape directly.

name: direct_push_pull
description: Drive a solid's faces along their own normals, Plasticity-style. A positive distance adds material, a negative one takes it away. Curved faces follow the same rule: push a hole's wall outward by 1 and the hole's radius grows by 1.

name: display_refine
description: Give the 3D view a refined, Plasticity-like look: MSAA anti-aliasing, curved faces tessellated more finely, crisp dark edges kept thin, softer satin shading lit by a key and a fill, a dark gradient behind the model, and meshes drawn smooth-shaded. Objects already open are updated too. Everything it changes is saved first, so display_restore can put it back. Views opened afterwards pick up the anti-aliasing.

effects.description: Plasticity-style matcap shading, silhouette outlines and hidden seams

name: display_restore
description: Reverse display_refine: drop the viewport effects and put every display preference it touched back as it was.

name: doc_close
description: Close a document, saving it first when save=True.

name: doc_get_properties
description: Read the document's own properties: Label, Comment, Company and the rest.

name: doc_list
description: Name every FreeCAD document currently open.

name: doc_new
description: Open a fresh, empty FreeCAD document and make it the active one.

name: doc_open
description: Load a FreeCAD document from disk (.FCStd, or any format that can be imported).

name: doc_recompute
description: Recompute the named document, or the active one, whether or not it looks stale.

name: doc_redo
description: Reapply whatever was last undone in the active document.

name: doc_save
description: Save the named document, or the active one. To write it somewhere new, use doc_save_as.

name: doc_save_as
description: Write the named document, or the active one, to the path given.

name: doc_set_active
description: Switch the active document to the one named.

name: doc_undo
description: Step the active document back by one operation.

name: draft_circle
description: Draft: draw a circle.

name: draft_line
description: Draft: draw a line between two points.

name: draft_text
description: Draft: place a text annotation.

name: draft_wire
description: Draft: run a polyline through a list of points.

name: freecad_python_eval
description: Evaluate one Python expression and hand back what it produces. Code spanning several statements belongs in freecad_python_exec.

name: freecad_python_exec
description: Run Python of your own inside FreeCAD's interpreter. Variables stay alive from one call to the next. Already imported for you: App (FreeCAD), Gui (FreeCADGui), Part, Draft, Sketcher and PartDesign. Anything written to stdout or stderr comes back.

name: gui_command_info
description: Report a GUI command's menu text, tooltip and pixmap.

name: gui_list_commands
description: Name every GUI command registered with FreeCAD; any of them can be handed to gui_run_command. A substring narrows the list.

with_info.description: Include menu text + tooltip for each command

name: gui_run_command
description: Fire a FreeCAD GUI command by name, such as 'Std_New', 'Part_Box' or 'PartDesign_Pad', exactly as picking it from a menu or toolbar would. gui_list_commands shows what is on offer.

name: io_export
description: Write objects out to a CAD file, taking the format from the extension (.step, .iges, .brep, .stl, .obj, .dxf, .svg and others).

objects.description: Object names; if empty, export all visible Part shapes

name: io_import
description: Read a CAD file (.step/.iges/.brep/.stl/.obj/.dxf/.svg/...) into a FreeCAD document, taking the format from the extension and creating a document first if none is open.

name: measure_bounding_box
description: Report the axis-aligned box that encloses an object's shape.

name: measure_distance
description: Find the shortest distance between two sub-elements. Write each as 'ObjectName', or 'ObjectName.Face1' / '.Edge2' / '.Vertex3'.

name: measure_mass_properties
description: Report an object's volume, surface area and centre of mass.

name: mesh_export
description: Write the selected objects, or ones you name, to a mesh file (.stl/.obj/...).

objects.description: If empty, export all visible Part shapes

name: mesh_import
description: Read a mesh file (.stl/.obj/.ply/...) into the active document.

name: mesh_import_file
description: Read a mesh file (.ply/.stl/.obj/...) into the active document and report the name of every object it produced. This is what File -> Import does in the GUI.

name: mesh_loft_solid
description: Turn a mesh back into a solid that booleans will accept: slice it at right angles to an axis you choose, take the outer silhouette of each slice, fit B-splines to those, and loft through them. Reach for this when the built-in 'shape from mesh' hands back a non-manifold solid that boolean operations reject. Every input is checked and resampled to a safe size, so OCC's loft algorithm cannot hang.

mesh_object.description: Name of the Mesh::Feature object to convert

n_slices.description: Number of cross-sections to extract (ignored if resolution_mm is set)

resolution_mm.description: Spacing between cross-sections in mm. If given, overrides n_slices.

points_per_slice.description: Points to resample each slice to before lofting

margin.description: Skip this many mm from each tip of the mesh's axis range (degenerate slices)

result_label.description: Name for the resulting solid object

keep_intermediate.description: Keep the intermediate B-spline wires in the document for inspection

hide_mesh_after.description: Hide the source mesh after the solid is built

loft_max_degree.description: Maximum B-spline degree for the loft surface. Lower = less overshoot, more facetted.

loft_ruled.description: If true, build flat ruled panels between consecutive wires (no smoothing).

name: mesh_rebuild_cad
description: Remodel a scanned mesh, or a faceted solid that came from one, as a clean CAD solid carrying as few faces as possible, the way it would look if drawn from scratch. It suits 2.5D parts such as plates, brackets and housings: the main axis and the height levels are found, each layer's outline is fitted with lines, arcs and circles, edges close to an axis are squared, dimensions that should agree are equalised, mirrored features are averaged on a symmetric part, sizes are rounded to `grid`, and the layers are then extruded and fused.

grid.description: Round dimensions to this step (mm); 0 = off

snap_angle.description: Snap edge angles to multiples of this (deg)

placement.description: overlay = on top of the scan; origin = axis-aligned at the origin

name: mesh_to_shape
description: Turn a Mesh::Feature into a Part (CAD) object. Facets are sewn into a shell, raised to a solid where the shell closes, and coplanar facets are merged (refine). The conversion is exact and stays faceted; for a smooth B-spline approximation of an organic mesh, use mesh_loft_solid.

refine.description: Merge coplanar facets into single faces

repair.description: Fix duplicates, degenerate facets and normals first

decimate_to.description: Optionally reduce the mesh to about this many facets first

name: mesh_to_solid_multi_axis
description: Turn a mesh back into a boolean-ready solid, slicing along one axis or several. Given a single axis the result matches mesh_loft_solid. Given two or three, each axis gets its own loft and the lofts are intersected (boolean common), so a concavity that one direction's convex-hull silhouette would swallow is still caught by another. Resolution sets the slice spacing in mm.

mesh_object.description: Name of the Mesh::Feature to convert

axes.description: Slicing axes. Multiple axes are intersected.

resolution_mm.description: Distance between consecutive cross-sections in mm

loft_ruled.description: Ruled loft (faceted, robust). Set false for smooth (may overshoot).

keep_per_axis_lofts.description: If true, keep the per-axis loft solids in the document for inspection

name: obj_delete
description: Remove an object from its document.

name: obj_get
description: Read every property of the object named.

name: obj_list
description: List a document's objects, giving Name, Label and TypeId for each.

name: obj_rename
description: Give an object a different user-visible Label.

name: obj_set_property
description: Write a property on an object. The value must be JSON-compatible. Give a vector as {x,y,z} and a placement as {Base:{x,y,z}, Rotation:{Axis:{x,y,z}, Angle: rad}}.

name: obj_set_visibility
description: Show an object in the 3D view, or hide it.

name: obj_shape_info
description: Examine an object's geometry: bounding box, volume, area, and the counts of vertices, edges and faces. Only Part-based objects carry this.

name: part_box
description: Make a Part::Box primitive.

name: part_compound
description: Gather objects into a Part::Compound: grouping only, with no boolean applied.

name: part_cone
description: Make a Part::Cone primitive.

name: part_create
description: Make any Part primitive. Give a TypeId such as 'Part::Wedge', 'Part::Ellipsoid' or 'Part::Prism', together with a dict of properties to apply.

name: part_cylinder
description: Make a Part::Cylinder primitive.

name: part_plane
description: Make a Part::Plane primitive.

name: part_sphere
description: Make a Part::Sphere primitive.

name: part_torus
description: Make a Part::Torus primitive.

name: pd_active_body
description: Report which PartDesign Body is active, or null when none is.

name: pd_chamfer
description: Chamfer a body's edges.

name: pd_create_body
description: Start a new PartDesign Body, which then becomes the active one.

name: pd_create_sketch
description: Put a Sketcher::SketchObject on a plane. The plane may be 'XY', 'XZ' or 'YZ', the name of a planar face such as 'Body.Face1', or another reference that already exists.

name: pd_fillet
description: Round an edge of a body. Pass edges as a list such as ['Edge1','Edge3'], numbered against the previous feature.

name: pd_pad
description: Extrude a sketch into a solid, within the active body or one you name.

name: pd_pocket
description: Use a sketch to cut a pocket into the active body.

name: pd_revolution
description: Sweep a sketch around an axis to produce a solid.

name: pref_get
description: Read a preference. Give group as a path such as 'User parameter:BaseApp/Preferences/View', and type as one of bool, int, uint, float or string.

name: pref_list
description: Name the preference subgroups sitting under a group.

name: pref_set
description: Write a preference; group and type mean what they mean for pref_get.

name: selection_add
description: Put an object into the selection, optionally narrowing to a sub-element such as 'Face1'.

name: selection_clear
description: Drop everything currently selected in the 3D view.

name: selection_get
description: Report what the 3D view has selected, objects and sub-elements alike.

name: selection_remove
description: Take an object back out of the selection.

name: server_ping
description: Check the server is alive without reading or touching FreeCAD state. It still answers while the main thread sits inside a long OCC operation.

name: shape_to_mesh
description: Run a Part shape through the standard mesher to produce a Mesh::Feature.

name: sketch_add_arc
description: Add an arc, given its centre, radius, start angle and end angle in degrees.

name: sketch_add_circle
description: Add a circle to a sketch, centred at cx,cy with radius r.

name: sketch_add_constraint
description: Constrain a sketch. type is one of Horizontal/Vertical/Coincident/Parallel/Perpendicular/Tangent/Equal/Symmetric/Distance/DistanceX/DistanceY/Radius/Diameter/Angle. args holds either (geom_index, point_pos) pairs or plain integers, depending on which constraint it is. value carries the number for a dimensional constraint, in mm or rad as the type requires.

name: sketch_add_line
description: Add a line segment to a sketch, with coordinates taken in the sketch plane (X,Y).

name: sketch_add_rectangle
description: Add a rectangle built from 4 joined line segments, and report the 4 geometry indices.

name: sketch_delete_geometry
description: Remove geometry from a sketch by index.

name: sketch_get_geometry
description: List every geometry element a sketch holds.

name: ss_create
description: Start a new Spreadsheet.

name: ss_get
description: Read a cell: both the raw expression it holds and the value it computes to.

name: ss_set
description: Write a cell, for instance cell='A1' with value='=2*3', 42 or 'hello'.

name: ss_set_alias
description: Give a cell an alias, so expressions can refer to it by name.

name: transform_copy
description: Produce a Part::Copy of an object, whose shape then stands on its own.

name: transform_mirror
description: Produce a Part::Mirroring of an object about a plane, which a base point and a normal define.

name: transform_rotate
description: Spin an object by an angle in degrees, about an axis passing through a centre point.

name: transform_set_placement
description: Give an object an absolute placement.

name: transform_translate
description: Shift an object by (dx, dy, dz), changing its Placement.

name: tree_expand
description: Open or close a node in the model tree.

name: tree_get
description: Report the document's object hierarchy, as the tree view shows it.

name: view_fit_all
description: Zoom and pan until everything sits inside the 3D view.

name: view_fit_selection
description: Frame whatever is selected in the 3D view.

name: view_get_camera
description: Read the active camera out as a string, in Inventor format.

name: view_redraw
description: Make the 3D view redraw at once.

name: view_screenshot
description: Render whatever the active 3D view shows to an image, returned as base64 and, when a path is given, written to disk as well. PNG unless told otherwise.

path.description: Optional file path to write to

name: view_set_camera
description: Point the active camera using an Inventor-format string, of the kind view_get_camera returns.

name: view_set_orientation
description: Swing the 3D view round to a named orientation.

name: workbench_activate
description: Switch to the workbench named, such as 'PartDesignWorkbench' or 'SketcherWorkbench'.

name: workbench_active
description: Report which workbench is active.

name: workbench_list
description: List the workbenches available, by internal name.
